title: BoundaryFace: A mining framework with noise label self-correction for Face Recognition
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical aspects of face recognition, specifically a new mining framework and noise label self-correction. While it discusses performance across different racial groups (Asian, Caucasian, Indian, African) for benchmarking purposes, this is related to 'bias' in model performance, not an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of the paper's focus.
